title: From Constraints to Causality: Petri net Encodings for Explaining Binary Neural Network Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.22396v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) are attractive for resource-constrained hardware and on-device components in autonomous systems. However, their discrete, non-linear behaviour makes them difficult to analyse and trust in safety-relevant settings. Existing approaches based on SAT and Satisfiability Modulo Theories can verify a BNN's input-output properties, but treat it as a monolithic constraint system, which reveal only whether a property holds and not how the computation reaches its result. In this paper, we present an early work that provides a complementary, discrete-event view. We give a compositional translation from the inference semantics of a fixed, trained BNN to a 1-safe Petri net (PN), where each computation step is an explicit transition, so that a firing sequence is a causal trace of the BNN's decision. On a worked example, we establish faithfulness via exhaustive input-output equivalence against a reference implementation,

translated_title: 从约束到因果性：用于解释二值神经网络推理的Petri网编码
translated_abstract: 二值神经网络对于资源受限的硬件以及自主系统中的设备端组件极具吸引力。然而，其离散的、非线性的行为使其在安全相关场景中难以被分析和信任。现有的基于SAT（可满足性）与SMT（可满足性模理论）的方法能够验证BNN的输入-输出性质，但它们将BNN视为一个整体性的约束系统，这只能揭示某个性质是否成立，而无法揭示计算是如何得出结果的。在本文中，我们提出了一项提供互补性离散事件视角的早期工作。我们给出了一种组合式的翻译方法，将一个固定的、已训练的BNN的推理语义翻译为1-安全Petri网（1-safe Petri net），其中每个计算步骤都是一个显式的变迁（transition），从而使一个引发序列成为BNN决策的因果轨迹。在一个具体实例上，我们通过与参考实现进行穷尽的输入-输出等价性验证，确立了该翻译的忠实性。
tldr: 本文提出一种组合式翻译方法，将固定的已训练二值神经网络的推理过程编码为1-安全Petri网，使每个引发序列都能成为其决策的因果轨迹，从而在传统SAT/SMT验证之外为BNN推理提供了因果层面的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compositional translation that encodes the inference of a fixed, trained binary neural network into a 1-safe Petri net, where each firing sequence serves as a causal trace of its decision, offering causal explainability beyond traditional SAT/SMT verification.
